rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193));
rect.title: The canary PCBA (canary step C1): the connector X1 for the canary link, with R1 between its two pins (nets CANARY_A, CANARY_B). X1 carries portName = canaryLink, portType = CanaryHeader and portTypeID = EE-PORT-0001 in the schematic, and CK-F1 compares them and its pins and nets with the pin map below.

g.text: Legend (allocation): white = the domain model, grey = the system model it refines; sharp box = definition with its
«keyword» and <need ID>. Dashed arrows are the trace links of the needs, from the concrete to the abstract element:
«realizes» (a system element), «conforms» (a system interface), «satisfies» (a requirement), derived from :>
specialization, dependency and allocate; and the structure links inside the domain: «part of» (a port of its board or
assembly), «connects» (a harness and the ports its ends mate with). A box links to its need.
